title: Jubilant Springy Ukrainian Lamb Skewers
description: A roasted and energizing Ukrainian dish featuring turmeric and yuzu-cure, perfect for a spring evening, this egg-free friendly recipe is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together turmeric, yuzu juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a hot stone plate and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Flip the skewers over and continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
